summary: EShallGo Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held October 10, 2026 (Shanghai time). Record-date holders were 5,536,577 Class A and 366,000 Class B ordinary shares; approximately 97.12% of voting power was present. Shareholders approved a five-for-one share consolidation (par US$0.0016 to US$0.008), an amended memorandum and articles reflecting the new authorized capital, and a transfer by way of continuation from the Cayman Islands to the British Virgin Islands. All resolutions passed overwhelmingly; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed. Watch for post-consolidation trading mechanics and the migration's regulatory clock.
